footer.tagline: imago: one account for every application on manasomali.com

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a 6-digit code. One account works in every application on manasomali.com; if you do not have one yet, it is created when you confirm the code.
login.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
login.resend_in: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
login.consent: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> (links open in a new tab).
login.account_deleted: Your account was deleted from every application. We sent a confirmation to your email.

terms_acceptance.title: New terms of use
terms_acceptance.text: The terms of use and the privacy policy of manasomali.com changed. To keep using the applications, read and accept the new version.
terms_acceptance.outdated: A newer version of the terms was published while this page was open. Reload the page to read it.
terms_acceptance.disagree: If you do not agree, you can delete your account on the <account>account page</account> without accepting.

terms_pending.title: New terms of use
terms_pending.text: The terms of use and the privacy policy changed. To keep using the applications and to change your language or time zone, read and accept the new version. If you do not agree, you can sign out or delete your account below.

email.title: Email
email.help: To change your email, write to <mail>{{supportEmail}}</mail> from the account's current email, saying what the new one is. Before changing it, support confirms the new email by asking for a reply sent from it, so a typo cannot hand the account to someone else. After the change, you need to sign in again on every device.
email.lost_access: Lost access to the current email? Write anyway, from another address. In that case, support asks for information only the account's user knows (such as data in the applications) before deciding.

apps.title: Your applications
apps.intro: This account signs you in to all of them.

language.title: Language
language.help: The language of the emails from manasomali.com and its applications (codes, invites and alerts). When you save, it also becomes the screen language in this browser.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.help: The time zone of every application (in ethos, it sets the calendar days, the score and the alert times). Current account time zone: {{timezone}}.
timezone.device: This device is in another time zone: {{timezone}}.
timezone.search: Search time zone (city, region or UTC-03)

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.sign_out_help: Ends the session on this device only, in every application.
sessions.sign_out_all_help: Ends the session on every device, this one included. Use it if you lost a device or signed in on a computer that is not yours.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deletes the account and your data in every application right away. First, the screen shows what goes away and where to take a copy of your data.
delete.warning_title: What goes away with the account
delete.warning_intro: Deletion is immediate, applies to every application and cannot be undone. Gone for good:
delete.lose_account: your manasomali.com account: email, language, time zone, sessions and the record of your sign-ins;
delete.backups: Deleted data still stays a few days in the backups, until they expire (see the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>, which opens in a new tab).
delete.export_title: Take a copy of your data
delete.export_text: Optional. Each application has its own export. After deletion, there is nothing left to download.
delete.export_none: None of your applications has an export.
delete.export_new_tab: The links open in a new tab; come back here to continue.
delete.request_text: We will send a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
delete.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
delete.final_confirm: I understand the account and the data in every application go away right away and this cannot be undone.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.text: This address does not exist or has changed.

ethos.name: ethos
ethos.description: Track habits on a yearly calendar, alone or shared with other people.
ethos.deletion: the habits you own, with all their marks (guests' marks included; guests lose access and get an email about it), your participation in other people's habits, the invites you sent or received and your alerts. The marks you made in other people's habits stay in those habits, shown as by “Removed user”.
ethos.export_label: Export everything from ethos (on the report screen)

errors.bad_request: The request could not be understood. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.conflict: This conflicts with another change. Reload the page and try again.
errors.validation_error: Some field is invalid. Check it and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
errors.database_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
errors.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code. Check the code or request a new one.
errors.invalid_timezone: Unknown time zone. Choose another one.
errors.terms_not_accepted: Accept the new version of the terms of use to continue.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active administrator account: it cannot be blocked or deleted. Make another account an administrator first.
errors.email_in_use: This email already belongs to an account. Choose another one.
errors.cannot_block_self: You cannot block your own account.
errors.mail_quota: The email sending limit was reached. Please try again later.
errors.network_error: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.session_not_saved: The code was accepted, but this browser did not keep the session. Allow cookies for manasomali.com and sign in again.
